name: Higgsfield MCP Connector Setup in Claude Desktop
summary: Configure the Higgsfield remote MCP connector URL within Claude Desktop Settings to enable AI video generation capabilities.
steps: Navigate to higgsfield.ai/mcp in Google Chrome.
Copy the remote MCP connector URL string.
Open Claude Desktop app, click user profile icon, and open Settings.
Select Connectors tab and click Add Custom Connector.
Type 'Higgsfield' in the connector name field.
Paste the remote MCP URL into the Remote MCP Server URL input field.
Click Add and authorize tool permissions for Higgsfield MCP video generation tools.
jarvis_use: Configure Higgsfield MCP in Claude to enable autonomous video asset creation within AI workflows.

name: Unbroken 30-Second Video Generation via Seedance 2.5
summary: Generate up to 30 seconds of continuous video without clip stitching or continuity drift using Seedance 2.5 omni_reference mode.
steps: Set video model generation parameter mode to omni_reference.
Cap output resolution parameter at 720p.
Define desired aspect ratio (e.g., 16:9 or 21:9).
Set generate_audio to false if sound is unneeded.
Execute Seedance 2.5 API request via Higgsfield MCP for an unbroken take up to 30 seconds.
jarvis_use: Generate seamless extended video clips for application visual backgrounds without stitching artifacts.

name: Visual Continuity Anchoring via Primary Keyframe Asset
summary: Pass a single hero reference image asset ID as start_image across downstream multi-scene video prompts to lock aesthetic continuity.
steps: Generate a primary hero image reference asset using text-to-image generator (e.g., GPT Image 2).
Store the resulting visual asset reference ID.
Pass the reference asset ID into Seedance 2.5 start_image parameter for all subsequent scene prompts.
Maintain identical lighting, surface physics, and product styling across all generated video scenes.
jarvis_use: Maintain strict aesthetic and subject consistency when building multi-part visual assets.

name: FFmpeg Video Frame Extraction for Canvas Scrubbing
summary: Extract a 180-frame image sequence at 1600px width and quality 86 from an unbroken video file using FFmpeg.
steps: Pass generated 30-second continuous video clip to FFmpeg CLI script.
Run FFmpeg extraction command targeted at exactly 180 total keyframes.
Set target image output width to 1600px and quality compression level to 86.
Export the indexed frame sequence into the web project assets directory.
jarvis_use: Automate video conversion into lightweight image sequences for smooth scroll or drag animations.

name: Scroll-Driven Video Frame Scrubbing Engine
summary: Bind browser viewport scroll position to an indexed HTML5 canvas or image sequence for zero-latency scroll-based video scrubbing.
steps: Preload extracted keyframe image sequence into browser memory.
Add dynamic window scroll event listener measuring scroll depth percentage.
Map scroll percentage to sequential image frame index array.
Render active frame index to HTML5 canvas or full-bleed image container element.
jarvis_use: Build dynamic scroll-animated landing pages and interactive intros.

name: Drag-to-Spin 360-Degree Interactive Product Viewer
summary: Convert a 10-second seamless camera-locked turntable video into 72 scrubbable image frames bound to horizontal drag gestures.
steps: Prompt Seedance 2.5 to generate a 10-second turntable video with fixed camera and matching start/end frames.
Slice video into 72 sequential image frames using FFmpeg.
Create HTML/JS component registering mouse pointer and touch drag event listeners.
Map horizontal drag delta to index navigation through the 72 image frames.
jarvis_use: Construct interactive 360-degree product inspection widgets for Mac app interfaces.

name: Interactive Architectural Cutaway Floor Selector
summary: Slice exploded architectural floor cutaway video renders into floor-level keyframe cuts linked to dynamic navigation tabs.
steps: Prompt Seedance 2.5 to generate an architectural cutaway render showing levitating floor plates.
Extract per-floor individual keyframe images using FFmpeg cropping scripts.
Prompt Claude Code to write a web listing interface with floor selector navigation tabs.
Link floor tabs to cutaway image swaps and detailed room inventory data cards.
jarvis_use: Create multi-layer interactive system schematics or architectural floor selection tools.

name: Automated Viewport Resizing for Collapsed Canvas Recovery
summary: Detect collapsed zero-height canvas layout errors during automated testing and inject script overrides to force valid dimensions.
steps: Run automated headless browser interaction checks via Claude Code scripts.
Detect DOM collapse error where hidden panes cause WebGL/Canvas height to drop to zero.
Inject DOM script override forcing real target viewport dimensions.
Re-evaluate layout assertions and confirm correct rendering output.
jarvis_use: Self-detect and repair canvas viewport glitches during autonomous web application testing.

name: Localhost Verification Loop Prompting Pattern
summary: Append explicit execution and testing directives to agent prompts to enforce local server startup and DOM validation prior to completion.
steps: Draft main web development task instructions for Claude Code.
Append prompt clause: 'Launch on localhost and verify every scroll animation works before telling me it's done.'
Allow Claude Code to launch a local server process on an open port (e.g. 4999, 4977).
Permit agent execution loop to validate interactive elements and resolve console errors automatically.
jarvis_use: Ensure autonomous coding agents start local test environments and verify functionality before concluding tasks.

name: Background Scrim and Off-Center Copy Layout Safeguards
summary: Enforce dark gradient scrim overlays and off-center text positioning rules to protect readability over dynamic video visual backdrops.
steps: Position hero text elements in an off-center column (e.g. left 40% area).
Target video subject framing to occupy the opposite visual area (e.g. right 60% background space).
Apply a dark gradient CSS overlay scrim over the background video element.
Include a percentage loading counter screen to prevent flash of unstyled content during asset download.
jarvis_use: Apply contrast and readability layout safeguards automatically when placing text over video backdrops.
